description:
Assessment B3, Test Case 1: validate the EMI pie chart.
  The expected EMI is computed independently by the test suite from the loan inputs,
  never read back from the application.

elements.name: Home loan EMI and pie chart match an independent calculation

steps.name: I open the EMI calculator
I select the "Home Loan" tab
I enter a loan amount of 50L, an interest rate of 7.5% and a tenure of 15 years
the displayed EMI matches my independently calculated EMI
the displayed total interest and total payment match my calculation
the pie chart is visible with 2 sections
the pie chart sections match my calculated principal and interest
both pie chart sections show numerical values greater than zero

description:
Assessment B3, Test Case 2: validate the EMI bar chart.
  Values are set by interacting with the sliders. The expected yearly schedule (bar count and
  tooltip values) is computed independently by the test suite from the loan inputs and the
  chosen start month, so the test does not depend on the date it runs.

elements.name: Bar chart matches an independent amortization schedule

steps.name: I open the EMI calculator
I select the "Personal Loan" tab
I use the sliders to set a loan amount of 10L, an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
the displayed EMI matches my independently calculated EMI
I change the schedule start month to January of next year
the bar chart is visible
the bar chart has one bar per calendar year of the schedule, 5 in total
the yearly interest and principal in the bar chart match my amortization schedule
I hover over the Interest bar of the second year of the schedule
the tooltip shows that year's Interest and total payment from my amortization schedule

description:
The API answers every request with a meaningful status code and, for errors, an RFC 9457
  problem document. It never fails with a server error.

description: GET /api/teams lists the 10 IPL teams, optionally sorted.

elements.name: List all teams

steps.name: I request the teams list
the response status is 200
the response matches the "team list" contract
the response contains 10 items

elements.name: An unknown parameter is rejected

steps.name: I send a GET request to "api/teams?foo=1"
the response status is 400
the problem lists only an error for "foo" with code "unknown_parameter" and message "foo is not a supported parameter"

elements.name: Sort teams by name, descending

steps.name: I request the teams list with:
the response status is 200
the response matches the "team list" contract
the items are ordered by "name" descending
the item ids are, in order: "SRH, RCB, RR, PBKS, MI, LSG, KKR, GT, DC, CSK"

elements.name: An unsortable field is rejected

steps.name: I request the teams list with:
the response status is 400
the response is a problem document with title "Bad Request"
the problem lists an error for "sort" with code "invalid"

elements.name: Sort teams by titles (descending), then by name

steps.name: I request the teams list with:
the response status is 200
the response matches the "team list" contract
the items are ordered by "titles" descending, then by "name" ascending
the item ids are, in order: "CSK, MI, KKR, GT, RR, SRH, DC, LSG, PBKS, RCB"

name: Teams endpoint
